SELECT B.TEMPLATE_ID, B.APP_ID, B.ORGAN_ID, B.PROVIDER_ID, B.PROVIDER_NAME, B.FOREIGN_ID, B.TYPE, B.SUB_TYPE, B.NAME, B.SIGNATURE, B.CONTENT, B.PRIORITY, B.STATUS, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DEL_FLAG, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPARE1, B.SPARE2 FROM PUBLIC_TEMPLATE_INFO B WHERE 1=1
